# Labelled sentences for the Housekeeping Tracker's sweep (DESIGN.md section 32, items.SWEEP_PATTERNS).
#
# One sentence per line: "1<TAB>text" is a promise or an admitted gap the sweep should propose,
# "0<TAB>text" is narration, a fact or finished work it should leave alone. The sentences are
# written in the style of the factory's durable agent text (final replies, build.md Log and
# Validation sections, review Checks, decision.md Why), including the narration that trips simple
# patterns. They are not yet taken from the owner's real factory logs: replace and extend them
# with real ones as the logs accumulate, and tune the patterns against them (the research note's
# lesson from email commitment detection: patterns tuned on one corpus do worse on another).
